snippet.title: Phasmophobia - Cursed Hollow Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Cursed Hollow tasks Ghost Hunters with uncovering the secrets of the Cursed Hollow by identifying ghosts, completing objectives and discovering the totems scattered across the maps. Be warned however, activating these totems is likely to affect that which haunts you - the Forest Spirit. These effects may play in your favour, or up the challenge for you and your team.

Maps featured in Cursed Hollow will be decorated with all manner of event theming fit for the Forest Spirit.
